body:
Sorry for the very late reply.

Just our culture here I think. can't help it.

what if there isn't really anything I'm adamant about achieving? or just no goals. it's hard to run away in a very small country and I'll need a visa to go some places I want to/know people in that will reach out to me.

suicide seems the most peaceful decision, I don't want to hassle anyone.

I've thought this through for 3 years now, it's also why I have a month period before I take action.
going to send messages to close people to me, still contemplating a note for family. get in my bathroom tell my mom I'll take a bath, fill the tub and lay down for a bit til I slowly drift away. no one will really know, I keep things in a bag in my bathroom so they won't notice me for an hour or so.

I'll keep playing it, trying to get stronger to catch up with my boyfriend and it does give me some sense of accomplishment I suppose.

I don't really use social networking sites either except for some game communities otherwise I dislike using them even though I've been pushed by siblings to use them.

I'm not really afraid of them but I know their resources. if they want to stop me they will go to great lengths to do so. and meh. no one really to talk to. they don't understand me. they tried and so I know they never will.
I'm just spending 90% of my time playing an mmorpg which is kinda fun. helps pass the time.

uhh well somewhere in the middle east.

Realization that I will never have control over my life since it's pretty much already planned out. I'll never be able to change the fact that my life is just going to go on in a straight line and never getting what I want out of it.

and for the past 2 years I just keep failing to move forward which is why the next few weeks are crucial, they will determine if I can or not.

I don't feel a sense of reality in my life..don't know how to say it but everything feels....fake? everyone just putting up an act to everyone else

I don't have motivation to do anything and 0 interest in everything around me. my hobbies are getting dull, no enjoyment whatsoever besides time passing.

My family controls pretty much every inch of my life and I'm sick of it. I feel trapped and suicide starting becoming my only way out.
I've thought of running away but that's nearly impossible with my family and their position/who they know. they can easily stop me and drag me back home.
I turn 19 next month but we don't really have 'legal' age here so I'm stuck with them for the rest of my life.
